findings.source_quote: ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς
findings.english_quote: [ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς]
findings.issue: This surviving wording is reproduced in Greek rather than translated. It is not a printed lacuna. Even the recognizable temporal wording ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ receives no English representation, and the construction ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς remains unexplained. Independently, ὑποκειμένης can plausibly take the preceding ὕλη as its understood referent; uncertainty about that referent alone therefore does not establish corruption. Nevertheless, this does not explain ἕως φυσικῆς or supply the missing English meaning. The disclosure is honest, but it cannot make untranslated surviving wording satisfy coverage. The block concerns missing meaning, not merely the existence of alternatives or an unverified print.
findings.suggested_revision: Establish a defensible lexical and syntactic account of the unchanged ἕως φυσικῆς, including its relationship to ὑποκειμένης and the surrounding sentence, and translate the entire phrase with any material alternatives documented. The adjacent account of separation over time does not establish the proposed substitution ὕλης for ἕως. Do not adopt that conjecture as the selected reading or an English completion without supporting evidence. If no defensible rendering of the supplied construction can be established, retain the publication block. Any replacement must undergo fresh review.
